name: GrafanaLoki
description: Loki: like Prometheus, but for logs. Loki is a horizontally-scalable, highly-available, multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus. It is designed to be very cost effective and easy to operate. It does not index the contents of the logs, but rather a set of labels for each log stream. Download the local-config.yaml file from https://github.com/natcoso9955/Unraid-docker/blob/master/configs/loki/local-config.yaml before you start the container. Will need to be placed into your Host Path 1 directory.
